en.title: Monster and The Traitors Drop New Seasons: What to Watch Thursday
en.summary: Two highly anticipated series, **Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story** and **The Traitors: New Blood**, are set to premiere this Thursday. Fans of true crime and high-stakes reality competition will have plenty to dive into.
en.body:
Get ready, binge-watchers! This Thursday, September 17, 2026, brings a double dose of must-watch television with the highly anticipated premieres of **Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story** on Netflix and **The Traitors: New Blood** on NBC. For fans of Ryan Murphy's *Monster* anthology series, the latest installment dives deep into one of history's most infamous unsolved mysteries. The show promises to explore the life and alleged crimes of Lizzie Borden, a figure whose name has become synonymous with a brutal axe murder that shocked a nation. The series is expected to dissect the events leading up to and following the murders of Andrew and Abby Borden, offering a fresh, albeit fictionalized, perspective on the case that has captivated true crime enthusiasts for generations. The Netflix release makes it readily available for global audiences eager to dissect every clue and performance.

Meanwhile, the world of strategic deception and social manipulation gets a major boost with the debut of **The Traitors: New Blood** on NBC. This latest iteration of the hit reality competition promises to bring back the intense psychological gameplay that made its predecessors so addictive. The format, which pits unsuspecting contestants against a secret group of 'traitors' aiming to sabotage their efforts, is renowned for its dramatic reveals and backstabbing. The show will also be available for streaming the next day on Peacock, ensuring that even those who can't catch it live can join the water-cooler conversation. The teaser from NBC highlighted the core appeal: "Ordinary people. Extraordinary deceit." This season is poised to deliver the same thrilling blend of strategy, paranoia, and unexpected alliances that has cemented **The Traitors** as a dominant force in reality television.

## What Fans Are Saying
The online buzz surrounding both premieres is palpable. Social media feeds are alight with discussions about the potential for **Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story** to deliver another captivating, albeit chilling, performance, much like previous seasons of the *Monster* franchise. Fans are eager to see how the show will tackle the complex narrative of Lizzie Borden, with many speculating about the creative liberties Ryan Murphy and his team will take. For **The Traitors: New Blood**, the anticipation is equally high. Viewers are already debating who might be a traitor, sharing their favorite moments from past seasons, and predicting which contestants will crack under the pressure. The community aspect of **The Traitors** is a significant draw, with fans dissecting every move and confession, making it a truly interactive viewing experience. The dual release ensures that fans have compelling content across different genres, catering to diverse tastes within the dedicated viewing community.

## What's Next
Both **Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story** and **The Traitors: New Blood** premiere on Thursday, September 17, 2026. **Monster** will be available on Netflix, while **The Traitors** airs on NBC and streams the following day on Peacock. Viewers should prepare for a week filled with dark history and thrilling deception.
